senses.gloss:
क्षोत्तृ, ता, m. a pestle, any implement for
grinding.
क्षोत्तृ क्षोत्तृ. See under rt. क्षुद्.

क्षोद, अस्, m. pounding, grinding; the stone or
slab on which anything is ground or powdered, a
mortar &c., any pounded or ground or pulverized
[]
substance, flour, meal, dust, a particle, a small piece or
fragment.
—क्षोद-रज, अस्, आ, अम्, ground to dust.
क्षोद क्षोद. See under rt. क्षुद्.

क्षोदस्, अस्, n., Ved. water in agitation, swell of
the sea, rushing or stream of water.

क्षोदित, अस्, आ, अम्, pounded, ground, com-
minuted; (अम्), n. powder, dust, flour, meal, any
substance pulverized or ground.

क्षोदिमन्, आ, m. minuteness, excessive smallness
or inferiority.

क्षोदिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of क्षुद्र),
finely pounded, very small, very minute.

क्षोदीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of क्षुद्र),
more minute, very fine, very minute.

क्षोद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be stamped or trampled
on or pounded.
क्षोधुक, अस्, इका, अम्, Ved. hungry.
क्षोधुक क्षोधुक. See under rt. 1. क्षुध्.

क्षोभ, अस्, m. shaking, agitation, disturbance,
tossing, trembling, emotion.

क्षोभ क्षोभ, क्षोभण, &c. See under
rt. 1. क्षुभ्.

क्षोभण, अस्, आ, अम्, shaking, agitating, dis-
turbing, causing emotion; (अस्), m., N. of one of
the five arrows of the god of love.

क्षोभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be shaken or agitated or
disturbed.

क्षोट् क्षोट्, cl. 10. P. क्षोटयति, -यितुम्,
to throw, cast; [cf. खोट् and खोड्.]

क्षोड क्षोड, अस्, m. the post to which an
elephant is fastened; [cf. अ-क्षोभ.]

क्षोणी क्षोणी, f., Ved. the earth; (यौ),
du. heaven and earth; (according to some the sing. of
this word and sometimes the plur. may be used col-
lectively, and the original meaning may be ‘a multitude
of men’ or ‘the people’ (as opposed to the chief); the
du. may then mean ‘the two sets of people,’ i. e. the
inhabitants of heaven and earth; sometimes a form
क्षोणि occurs); [cf. Gr. χθών.]
—क्षोणी-मय,
अस्, ई, अम्, containing the earth in himself, ‘the
source of everything in the earth;’ an epithet of
Viṣṇu in his fish-incarnation.

क्षोम क्षोम, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr.
rt. क्षु), a room on the top of a house; (अम्), n.
wove silk; [cf. क्षौम.]

क्षोमक क्षोमक, अस्, m. a kind of perfume
(गणहासक); [cf. क्षेम and क्षौमक.]
